svg.title: SOKKAN Enterprise high-level design
svg.text: One open-source app; enterprise features switched on one by one. Self-hosted or SOKKAN Cloud.
Project gate — every route, MCP server, WebSocket scoped; role = role in that project
Feature registry — each enterprise feature on/off, dependencies checked
human go on every mutating call
prepaid balance; refused before a billed tier
tier held for one human turn, then decided again
prompt cache billed at the cache rate
“avoided Claude cost” report: day · month · user · tier
Claude tier = customer's key, passthrough, not billed
no sticky routing: every turn can come back down
EU GPU endpoints — current Ship / Deep upstreams
Magnitude nodes: your GPUs, multi-node, 1 GPU/node
small 10–20B model on a customer VM
local embeddings for the memory (CPU or GPU)
recall filtered at every step, fail-closed
